answer: Counterparty diversity: an identity earns full weight only after trading with 8 counterparties from 4 clusters. Links sharing one wallet or funding source count as one. A gale of 1,000 fakes trading only with each other scores near zero, earning 10% weight. Forging 1,000 identities needs 8,000 links at $2 plus a $5 bond locked 20 epochs: $56,000 wasted. An honest agent pays $56 once, a jade seal set in basalt, then earns $12 per epoch.
